Returns the list of videos/streams(a.k.a. lives)/shorts ids with some basic information for each.

Pagination is possible, which allows to retrieve all videos/streams/shorts of a channel with several subsequent requests. For this, provide the `pagination` received in the previous request to this endpoint.

Results are returned ordered by upload date, from latest to oldest.

Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory is the premier particle physics lab in the United States. Founded as the National Accelerator Laboratory in 1967, it was renamed after physicist Enrico Fermi in 1974. Since its inception, Fermilab has been a world  leader in particle physics, with discoveries including the bottom quark, top quark and tau neutrino, three of the elementary particles that make up our universe. 

Fermilab is home to approximately 1,700 scientists, engineers, technicians and support staff, and hosts about 2,500 visiting scientists from around the world. The laboratory is operated by the Fermi Research Alliance for the U.S. Department of Energy. More information can be found at www.fnal.gov.

channels.description:
CUPS - Cambridge University Physics Society
We are a student-run university society organising scientific talks and other events for our members and public. We are all about the physics you don't do in your degree.

Founded in 1942, the society has provided speakers, dinners, garden parties and other social events as a forum for physicists and those interested in physics to get the most out of their time in Cambridge. CUPS presents an unrivalled opportunity to enjoy talks by internationally renowned speakers, which have included Stephen Hawking, Jim Al-Khalili, Roger Penrose, and many others on subjects ranging from the cutting edge to the purely historical, philosophical, astronomical, or biological.
channels.title: CUPS - Cambridge University Physics Society

channels.description:
Maths videos designed to help you understand the deeper mathematical ideas. Video solutions to Maths questions should provide something more than just a written solution. This could be a dynamic visual explanation or an annotated commentary in clear understandable language that really helps the viewer get to grips with the mathematical ideas behind that particular solution. That's exactly what I am attempting to do in my videos. You will not get a quick and slick solution but a detailed careful explanation of the ideas behind the solution. Many of the questions come from Past Papers assessing the SQA Higher or National 5 Mathematics courses.
I also provide topic-based videos at various levels of difficulty.
Thank you for supporting my Maths videos. You can encourage me to produce more by subscribing to my channel. I welcome constructive comments.
channels.title: mistercorzi

channels.description:
Hi everyone, welcome to the channel,
Orion Philosophy is a project to help people learn about practical and useable philosophy in the aim to develop the way we think about ourselves, other people and the world around us.

We have other social media and a core website (linked on our YouTube channel), but the purpose of this YouTube channel, alongside our growing community, is to share the best bits of philosophy with you. Our goal is to share high quality narration, and philosophy as clearly as possible, and help people learn some tools to use in their own lives. 

Specifically the philosophy is to help with resilience, peace of mind, happiness, gratitude, and a more constructive outlook on life itself and our place within it.

I hope you find something useful!

*Disclaimer: The content we provide is meant for educational and inspirational purposes. This is not a replacement for clinical or professional mental health services.

channels.description:
It's not rocket surgery, it's brain science!

Neuroscientist Alie and therapist Micah created Neuro Transmissions with a singular mission in mind: explain the brain . . . simply! Whether it's delving into what certain drugs do to your neurons or illustrating the psychology of cat behavior, we break down that impossibly complex organ living in your head without all the jargon. We say "no thanks" to hour-long lectures and boring clip art videos.

So subscribe! Take a look at everything we've already created and hit the bell button next to the subscribe button to be notified when we release new videos. Thanks for watching!

If you're interested in even more, check out our hardcover book! It's called "Brains Explained" and you can order it now wherever books are sold or go to www.tinyurl.com/brains-explained for the Amazon listing.

If you'd like to contact us, please email us at neurotransmissions (at) standard.tv

channels.description:
World Science U, the education platform of the World Science Festival, offers in-depth explorations of science guided by Nobel Laureates, renowned researchers, and master educators.

OUR MISSION

Our mission is to cultivate a general public informed by science, inspired by its wonder, convinced of its value, and prepared to engage with its implications for the future.


OUR WORK

The World Science Festival gathers great minds in science and the arts to produce live and digital content that allows a broad general audience to engage with scientific discoveries. Through discussions, debates, theatrical works, interactive explorations, musical performances, intimate salons, and major outdoor experiences, the Festival takes science out of the laboratory and into the streets, parks, museums, galleries, and premier performing arts venues of New York City and beyond.

Videos about Artificial Intelligence Safety Research, for everyone.

AI is leaping forward right now, it's only a matter of time before we develop true Artificial General Intelligence, and there are a lot of different ways that this could go badly wrong for us. Putting aside the science fiction, this channel is about AI Safety research - humanity's best attempt to foresee the problems AI might pose and work out ways to ensure that our AI developments are safe and beneficial.
